subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin charged in and successfully struck one of the swarms, dealing a significant blow.
source_quote: Thorin charges in, swinging with his weapon. Daz perks up as Thorin actually manages to strike one of the swarms, dealing a significant blow.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is second-guessing his spell choices, considering 'Burning Hands' or a wider-area spell, and feels unease over perceived spell ineffectiveness.
source_quote: Daz finds himself scanning his spell list, second-guessing his choices. 'Maybe 'Burning Hands' would have been better?' he muses, or perhaps something with a wider area of effect. He feels a slight unease, wondering if his spells are just ineffective or if he needs to re-strategize.

subject: centipedes
fact: The centipedes are relentless and unsettling, continuing to come despite being struck.
source_quote: the centipedes keep coming, relentless and unsettling.

subject: swarms
fact: One of the swarms was struck with a significant blow by Thorin.
source_quote: Thorin actually manages to strike one of the swarms, dealing a significant blow.

subject: phantom bug sensation
fact: Daz experiences a phantom sensation of bugs on his arms despite knowing none are present, and repeatedly scratches at his skin.
source_quote: He keeps scratching at his arms, feeling the phantom sensation of bugs despite knowing there were none on him.

subject: spell strategy reconsideration
fact: Daz is actively reconsidering his spell selection and strategy, questioning whether his current spells are inadequate or if a different approach is needed.
source_quote: Maybe 'Burning Hands' would have been better?" he muses, or perhaps something with a wider area of effect. He feels a slight unease, wondering if his spells are just ineffective or if he needs to re-strategize.
